name: DisequalityDispersion.Machine.isSrcNode_eq
typeText:
∀ (g : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance) (j : Nat) {m : DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Mem} {lo hi p : Nat},
  DisequalityDispersion.Machine.RepNode m lo hi p
      (List.getD.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.nodes (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g)) j
        (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Node.src 0)) →
    Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.isSrcNode g j) (Decidable.decide (Eq.{1} (m p) 0))

source.code:
theorem isSrcNode_eq (g : GInstance) (j : ℕ) {m : Mem} {lo hi p : ℕ}
    (h : RepNode m lo hi p (g.base.nodes.getD j (.src 0))) : g.isSrcNode j = decide (m p = 0) := by
  unfold GInstance.isSrcNode
  rcases repNode_cases h with ⟨h0, i, he, _⟩ | ⟨h1, f, args, he, _, _⟩
  · rw [he, h0]; rfl
  · rw [he, h1]; rfl
